argument_markdown:
Let X=M_{6,6}. By ATT-0120/CLM-0120-2--CLM-0120-4, Y is the reduced Zariski closure of the balanced ordered CE classifying image and T_Z is the kernel of restriction from T to the weight-26 cohomology of X\Y. Poincare-Verdier localization identifies it with im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q)->T).

This identification proves only that T_Z is a pure polarizable Hodge structure of weight -16. It does not determine its Hodge bidegrees. In particular, weight -16, Borel-Moore degree 16, and closed support inside a smooth 21-fold do not formally imply type (-8,-8): for an abelian ninefold A, the closed embedding A×{pt} into A×P^{12} maps H^2(A)(9) into weight -16 Borel-Moore degree 16 and retains the off-diagonal types (-7,-9) and (-9,-7).

Consequently a proof for this named T_Z requires additional geometry showing either that its image is supported in dimension at most eight, that the relevant lowest-weight groups on every residual stratum are Tate, or that every non-Tate summand of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) lies in the kernel of the map to T. None of these statements is supplied by ATT-0120 or its confirmation reviews. Conversely, the admitted non-Tate classes on arbitrary atlases or standalone CE models have no proved nonzero image in T_Z and therefore do not disprove the theorem.

Thus neither the required proof nor the required target-level disproof is established. Marking this artifact claimed_complete would assert an unsupported mathematical conclusion.

claims.statement: The verified interface identifies T_Z with ker(T->W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6}\Y;Q)(21)), equivalently with the image of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) in T.
Purity of weight -16 and support in a smooth 21-dimensional ambient space do not, without further geometric input, force a Borel-Moore degree-16 image to be a direct sum of Q(8).
The admitted standalone non-Tate CE-model classes do not constitute a disproof because no nonzero image of such a class in the named T_Z is proved.

failed_approaches_addressed.subject: Standalone non-Tate cohomology of an atlas or product CE model does not reach the named target image.
Purity and weight bookkeeping alone do not imply Tate type.
Artin vanishing lowers the possible support dimension only to 16 and does not control dimensions 9 through 16.
The verified interface supplies no regular embedding or Gysin computation.

gap_markers: The Hodge type of im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q)->T) is undetermined on residual support strata of dimensions 9 through 16, and no non-Tate summand is proved to survive this map.

proof_dependencies.note: Verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE defining Y, the restriction map, and the named kernel T_Z.
Independent confirmation of ATT-0120, including the distinction between the supports group and its image in T.
Second independent confirmation of ATT-0120 and its one-sided coverage clause.

summary: No complete proof or disproof can be certified from the admitted data. ATT-0120 identifies the named object as the image of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) in T, but no admitted result proves that image Tate, zero, or non-Tate. Claiming completion would require an unsupported Hodge-type assertion.

target_interface_reference.survival_or_tate_argument: No unconditional Tate or survival argument is available: the interface supplies the image map but neither proves its source Tate nor proves that its non-Tate part maps to zero or nonzero.
target_interface_reference.target_map_use: The target map is the verified inclusion phi:T_Z->T obtained from the kernel of open restriction; no Gysin map from the CE atlas or standalone Z is used.

not_covered: the complementary image of T in W_{26}H^{26}(U_Y;Q)(21)
objects: Y, the reduced classifying-image closure supplied by ATT-0120

theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
